title: Department of State AIRGRAM: Report of Unidentified Object Which Fell Near Municipio of General Teran, N.L. February 17, 1967
doc_notes: This document is a Department of State Airgram from the American Consulate in Monterrey regarding a report of an unidentified object falling in Mexico, intended for forwarding to NASA.

incidents.summary: An unidentified object reportedly fell near the Municipio of General Teran, Nuevo Leon, Mexico.
incidents.quote: Report of unidentified object which fell near Municipio of General Teran, N.L.
